description: A React component named ExampleApp that integrates with the Excalidraw drawing library, providing UI for drawing, exporting, comments, and collaboration features.

classes.name: AppProps
classes.description: TypeScript interface defining props for the ExampleApp component.

classes.name: Comment
classes.description: Type representing a comment with position and value.

classes.name: PointerDownState
classes.description: Type representing the state during a pointer down event for comments.

methods.name: renderExcalidraw
methods.description: Renders the Excalidraw component with passed children, injecting props and UI elements.

methods.name: renderTopRightUI
methods.description: Renders additional UI elements in the top right corner, including collaboration trigger and a button.

methods.name: loadSceneOrLibrary
methods.description: Loads a scene or library file into the Excalidraw scene.

methods.name: updateScene
methods.description: Updates the Excalidraw scene with predefined elements and app state.

methods.name: onLinkOpen
methods.description: Handles link opening events within the drawing.

methods.name: onCopy
methods.description: Copies the current scene to clipboard in specified format (png, svg, json).

methods.name: onPointerDown
methods.description: Handles pointer down events, initiating comment placement if active tool is comment.

methods.name: rerenderCommentIcons
methods.description: Repositions comment icons based on current viewport and scene coordinates.

methods.name: onPointerMoveFromPointerDownHandler
methods.description: Handles pointer move events during comment placement, updating icon positions.

methods.name: onPointerUpFromPointerDownHandler
methods.description: Handles pointer up events, finalizing comment placement or toggling comment input.

methods.name: renderCommentIcons
methods.description: Renders comment icons on the drawing canvas.

methods.name: saveComment
methods.description: Saves the current comment, updating comment icons state.

methods.name: renderComment
methods.description: Renders the comment input box for adding or replying to comments.

methods.name: renderMenu
methods.description: Renders the main menu with export, collaboration, and help options.
